def Divides (a b : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : ℕ, b = a * q

difficulty.reason: one-line existential mirroring the source; Mathlib's `a ∣ b` on ℕ unfolds to the same shape

deviations: kept as a local definition `Divides` rather than mapping to `Dvd.dvd`, so that the demo exercises the whole pipeline; `Divides a b ↔ a ∣ b` is provable by `Iff.rfl`
